newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.5 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Friday conducted a round of special purchase and resale agreements in the money market at 3.5 percent.
The central bank intervened on money markets after the call loan or overnight lending rate traded at the top of the central bank's target range.
"The system's been on the tighter side since yesterday," said one T-bill dealer with a bank-owned brokerage. "Everybody is trying to clean up their balances now."
The call loan rate traded at 3.5 percent in the wake of the intervention, while the three-month when-issued T-bill traded with a yield of 3.34 percent.
